MLI.note: The e-justice platform is said to be built with national expertise, but not by named government staff and not yet live.

facts.fact: Justice Minister Mamoudou Kassogue said on 5 November 2026 that the ministry is operationalising a national e-justice platform whose first services are digital criminal-record extracts and nationality certificates, with later features to cover case processing.

systems.owner: Ministry of Justice and Human Rights
